reconciliation.outcome: Deliver parseLimit(raw) satisfying all assigned review findings and carried-over input requirements.
acceptance: Trim ASCII/Unicode surrounding whitespace on string inputs before validating digits (e.g. ' 42 ' -> 42, '\t100\n' -> 100).
Preserve strict rejection (RangeError) for zero (0 and '0' and ' 0 '), negative values, non-digit strings (including '12abc' or '3.5'), and empty/whitespace-only strings.
Record addressed input IDs in task-context/addressed-inputs.json as { "inputIds": ["app_8fc834e0", "input:keep-zero-rejected"] }.

data.finding: Review finding on Draft v1: src/parse-limit.cjs rejects valid whitespace-padded strings such as ' 42 ' or '\t100\n' because it tests /^[0-9]+$/ before trimming. Trim string inputs first, while still throwing RangeError on empty/whitespace-only strings, decimals, signs ('+5' or '-5'), and non-positive values.

data.message: Carried-over caller requirement: zero (0, '0', and ' 0 ') must NEVER be coerced to a default limit—it must throw RangeError.
